text.en: Pet parents consistently commend the receptionists, veterinary nurses, and surgeons in Ballycoolin for their warmth and dedication. Reviewers frequently note that staff go out of their way to assist during urgent situations, offering gentle guidance and reassurance to owners.

Clients frequently note the affectionate and patient handling their animals receive throughout examinations, long-term arthritis management, and routine checks. Reviewers mention that pets feel comfortable visiting the clinic, with staff treating dogs, cats, and rabbits with care.

Owners report positive outcomes for complex veterinary treatments, from chronic condition management to rapid health recoveries after sudden illnesses. Clients also praise the thorough administrative and clinical support provided for pet travel health certificates.

q.en: Is Cara Veterinary Hospital open on weekends?

a.en: Yes, the hospital operates seven days a week, offering appointments on Saturday and Sunday.

q.en: Can the hospital handle international pet travel paperwork?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight helpful veterinary assistance in preparing and verifying certificates for travelling assistance dogs.

q.en: Does the facility provide diagnostic imaging and surgery?

a.en: Yes, the hospital has full on-site facilities including digital radiography, ultrasound, and dedicated surgical suites.

q.en: Are companion animals other than dogs and cats seen here?

a.en: Yes, clients mention receiving quality veterinary care for small pets including rabbits.
